title: BEYOND THE FINAL LAYER: INTERMEDIATE REPRESENTATIONS FOR BETTER MULTILINGUAL CALIBRATION IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating accuracy and confidence calibration metrics (Expected Calibration Error, Brier score, and AUROC) on multilingual multiple-choice question-answering datasets (MMMLU and Belebele) across over 100 languages, comparing English performance against non-English languages and high-resource against low-resource languages using layer-wise probing.
